**Searching for file metadata**

I need to perform a search to find a temporary filename, which should yield the file itself, along with any potential evidence contained in the file metadata. This will help ensure I gather all necessary information related to the document. I'll make sure the search is thorough to capture all relevant details. Keeping track of metadata is crucial, so I want to ensure nothing gets overlooked in the process!
